SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, the only decent thing in here today is the rolled omelet—

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，今天能吃的只有玉子燒而已了

SCRIPT.SPANISH: Hoy solo tengo esto para comer,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، تنها چیزی که امروز اینجاست، املت رول شده است-

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: and you’re seriously asking for all of it?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それ全部くれってどういうことですか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: e ainda quer que eu dê tudo?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: و شما به طور جدی همه اونو می خواهید؟

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 为点吃的至于这么小气嘛
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 幹嘛為了一點吃的這麼小氣
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 食べ物くらいでケチケだな
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No seas mezquino con la comida.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: عجب ... خسیس بیش از حد غذا؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’re the one who begged for it first!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 明明是科长你先开口要的...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 課長の方が先にくれって言ったじゃないですか…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yang minta duluan juga kamu, tahu!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas quem tá sendo mesquinha é você!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: تو اولین کسی هستی که برایش التماس کردی!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 어? 아 오늘 계란말이 나와서 그랬구나
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh, rolled omelet’s on the menu today—makes sense now.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 咦？啊~看来是因为今天有鸡蛋卷才这样的啊
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 喔？啊，看來是今天有玉子燒才這樣啊

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então era por causa dos rolinhos de ovo...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Así que era por los rollitos de huevo...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، املت های رول شده امروز در منو است - اکنون منطقی است.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 유만 씨랑 싸우지 마시고 제 거 드세요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t fight over it, Yuman. You can have mine.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 别跟宥万争了，吃我这份吧
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 別跟宥萬先生吵了，吃我的吧

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jangan rebutan, Yuman. Punya aku ambil aja.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não briga com o Yumán, pega o meu.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No pelee con Yumán y tome el mío.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سرش دعوا نکن، یومان. تو میتونی مال من رو داشته باشی

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Wuseon~ Kamu emang paling ngerti situasi!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Wooseon~! Você é sempre tão atencioso!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ووسون~ شما همیشه حال و هوا را می شناسید!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 제가 과장님 관해서 꽉 잡고 있잖아요~
